data.name: Little Warrior
data.detailed_description:
Game Overview

Little Warrior is a top-down action roguelite built around the fun of creating your own build.

Choose from a staff, greatsword, bow, sword & shield, or dual blades, then shape your combat style through a six-slot upgrade grid, class growth, equipment, and cards.

There is no single correct answer. Every choice can change the way you fight.

Twin-Stick Manual Combat

The game uses twin-stick manual aiming.

Each weapon has its own rhythm and feel:
the bow rewards spacing and kiting, the greatsword focuses on charged heavy strikes, dual blades encourage close-range combos, sword & shield balances offense and defense, while the staff offers a ranged spellcasting style.

Your movement, aim direction, and skill timing all directly affect the outcome of battle.

Six-Slot Build System

In each run, your growth is shaped by a six-slot upgrade grid.

Choose from randomly appearing skills and place them into your limited 6 slots. Upgrades are not just about stacking numbers. Matching attributes and different combinations can create synergies and unlock extra build rewards.

Will you push one direction to the extreme, or mix several abilities together?
Every run asks you to decide your own growth path.

Three Classes, Three Playstyles

Your warrior’s combat identity is defined by the class you choose.

Gardener
Plant and grow turrets on the battlefield. Build defensive lines, lure enemies into your fire zone, and win through area control.

Lumberjack
Chop trees to gather wood. Wood is both ammunition and burst potential. Decide when to save it, when to spend it, and when to turn your stored resources into powerful damage.

Chef


Place a cooking pot, control the heat, and lift the lid at the right moment to release built-up pressure. Control the rhythm of battle with timing and preparation.

Three classes. Three resource loops. Three build directions.

Equipment, Cards, and In-Run Growth

Outside of battle, you can buy and upgrade equipment in town to adjust your base stats for the next challenge.

During a run, necklaces, rings, and bracelets can appear as additional equipment slots, offering deeper support for your class route and combat style.

In Hard Mode, the card system introduces higher-level build choices. Use cards to accelerate your class engine, protect key resources, or amplify a specific build payoff.

Challenge Again, Grow Stronger

At the end of each run, the results screen shows your build composition, skill damage, and major threat sources.

Review your choices, adjust your build direction, and come back stronger in the next run.

Easy to pick up, satisfying to master.
Victory is not just about luck — it is shaped by your choices.

data.short_description: Little Warrior is a cute pixel-art twin-stick action roguelite. Choose staff, greatsword, bow, sword & shield, or dual blades. Build skills on a 6-slot grid, then play as a Gardener, Lumberjack, or Chef. Gear rarity and stat rerolls shape each run. Victory depends on your choices.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 520 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 730
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad supported. Keyboard and mouse supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad recommended. Keyboard and mouse supported.
